content:
Mini PC manufacturer VZMORE has launched an early Black Friday deal for its AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470-powered VZMORE AX9 Max model: $229 off, bringing the regular price down to $1,270 from $1,499. The VZMORE AX9 Max mini PC ships with 32GB DDR5 and a 1TB NVMe SSD preloaded with Windows 11 Pro. It features four video outputs (2x HDMI 2.1, 2x USB-C) , a 3.5mm audio jack, two 2.5GbE ports, and WiFi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, as well as a range of USB 2.0, USB 3.2, and USB4 ports.
